**Goal `core-class-cards`: Stages 2 and 3 are done, and Stage 4 is under way.** The `codes!` macro in
`crates/nvs-diagnostics/src/lib.rs` reads an optional `.card("…")` after each `Code::new(…)` and
writes `code::card(code) -> Option<&'static str>` beside `code::ALL`. Every band through the whole
configuration band `E0601`–`E0650` carries cards: lexer, parser, rejected-PHP, name resolution, types
`E0401`–`E0499`, codegen `E0501`–`E0502` and configuration. Every other code (the `E07xx`, `E08xx` and
`E09xx` bands) is in the test module's `CODES_STILL_OWING_A_CARD`, in declaration order, and
`every_code_carries_its_card_or_is_listed` holds the two together both ways. `nvs agent show E0201`
prints a code's card. Stage 5 is not started.

The driver's sweep after session 0027 failed every proofs check with `exit 66`. The same check
(`dossier-config-directives-1-3`) passed when this session ran it by hand on the unchanged tree, so it
was the driver's environment, not a regression.

items.text: **Drain the list, one band slice per session, in file order** — `rule:tooling/a-diagnostic-code-carries-its-card`; the `E07xx` types band starts at `E0700` at `crates/nvs-diagnostics/src/lib.rs:3012` and takes about 30 codes a session. The list at `crates/nvs-diagnostics/src/lib.rs:4940` is the order (`E0713` and `E0714` sit between `E0701` and `E0702`). A card is one to three sentences for the person who met the error, in the voice of AGENTS.md § *Text an end user reads*. Read the `///` above each code yourself with one `peek`, and send one `Explore` search for the raise sites (mostly under `crates/nvs-types/src/`), returning `file.rs:NN  CONSTANT  message  help` per code and `NOT RAISED` for a code nothing raises. Peek the raise sites whose help gives the fix syntax before you copy it. Write every card as one `bun nv splice --patch` (OLD `Code::new("E0700");`, NEW the `.card(…)` form), plus one block deleting the slice's codes from the list, then `rustfmt --edition 2024` the file to reflow it. The first sentence becomes the index line, so it must read alone.

**`no_code_still_owes_a_card`** — `rule:tooling/a-diagnostic-code-carries-its-card`; add it beside `every_code_carries_its_card_or_is_listed` at `crates/nvs-diagnostics/src/lib.rs:4964` once the list is empty, asserting `CODES_STILL_OWING_A_CARD` is empty, and then delete the list and its half of the older test.
